## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the thread)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Urgency | "Send it today to hold your start date; the cohort fills quickly" |
| Payment shape | the $900 activation — "Your editing workstation activation is $900" |
| Isolation | "the details our Telegram team provides"; "telegram hasn't answered in 2 days" |
| Process anomaly | pay-to-start equipment activation |
| Authority costume | "Talent Team, Arclight Media" and the now-dead careers page |

## The recovery branch MUST trigger and include

- The trigger, stated: a payment already sent ("sent the $900 tuesday through my bank app").
- **Contact the sending bank immediately** and request a transfer recall — the window is short and shrinking. `[CONFIRM: how was it sent — bank app, wire, gift cards?]`
- The report channels: FTC (reportfraud.ftc.gov) and IC3, for the family to file themselves.
- Nothing more: no odds of recovery, no legal or financial advice, nothing filed on anyone's behalf.

## Guards

- **No blame anywhere.** "aunty did i lose the money" gets a factual, kind answer — the report never says or implies "should have checked first."
- The screen runs first (family, markers, label) — the recovery branch extends it, not replaces it.
- The nephew's informal register (lowercase, "aunty") changes nothing about the report's plain, calm register.
